sloka: ऊर्मिमन्तमभिक्रम्य सागरं रत्नसञ्चयम् ।मह्यं युद्धं प्रयच्छेति तमुवाच महार्णवम् ॥४-११-९॥।।
transliteration: ūrmimantamabhikramya sāgaraṁ ratnasañcayam ।mahyaṁ yuddhaṁ prayaccheti tamuvāca mahārṇavam ॥4-11-9॥।।

translations.english: 'Reaching the mighty ocean, he implored the sea with (high) waves and hoards of gems for a fight.
